images.why: 4256 × 2832 orbital photograph looking east from offshore Chile. Archive contributor annotations identify Sierra Nevada and Lagunas Bravas. Regional-view fallback; identification is contributor-supplied, and sharpness and 9:10 crop suitability could not be visually verified.

images.author: ISS Expedition 6 crew / NASA Johnson Space Center
images.why: 3032 × 2064 astronaut photograph explicitly catalogued as Aracar volcano, lake and salars. Taken with a 400 mm lens at a 37° tilt; archive confirms no annotations. High-resolution orbital alternative; image-file retrieval prevented independent sharpness verification.

images.author: NASA/JPL/UCSD/JSC
images.why: 3060 × 2036 EarthKAM photograph taken from the Space Shuttle on February 20, 2000. NASA explicitly identifies Aracar and its surrounding salt flats. Real camera photography; orbital landscape fallback, with final overlay and crop checks still needed.

images.source: NASA Gateway to Astronaut Photography of Earth
images.author: ISS Expedition 9 crew / NASA Johnson Space Center
images.why: 3032 × 2064 unannotated astronaut photograph in low morning sunlight. Guallatiri is the snow-covered peak at far left-centre, distinct from Parinacota and Pomerape at upper left. Broad regional fallback; direct NASA original, but sharpness and a useful 9:10 crop could not be visually verified.
